script: if ! command -v aws &>/dev/null; then curl -s 'https://awscli.amazonaws.com/awscli-exe-linux-x86_64.zip' -o /tmp/awscliv2.zip && unzip -q /tmp/awscliv2.zip -d /tmp && sudo /tmp/aws/install && rm -rf /tmp/awscliv2.zip /tmp/aws && echo 'AWS CLI installed'; else echo 'AWS CLI already installed'; fi

if [ -z "${B1_ACCESS_KEY_ID:-}" ] || [ -z "${B1_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY:-}" ] || [ -z "${WORKSPACE_ROOT:-}" ]; then echo 'Missing B1_ACCESS_KEY_ID, B1_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, or WORKSPACE_ROOT'; exit 1; fi && export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="${B1_ACCESS_KEY_ID}" && export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="${B1_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}" && echo 'Credentials validated'

description: Waiting for services to be healthy
